knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Storage security and vehicle access decide how well a mobile business runs. Rent alone does not.
A booking window tells the owner how far ahead to plan capacity and travel. It is not a price or a tax rate.
Chemicals are stored by their safety data sheet and kept apart from food. Home-based rules must be checked for the address.

practicalCriteria: Learner completes a base comparison table with cost, access hours, security, storage fit and the reason for the choice
Storage plan groups items by hazard and use, with chemicals kept apart from food and personal items
Service hours, booking window and confirmation step are written and checked against one typical week of availability
Every restriction or insurance point without a current source is left out, with an owner for the check
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed working document for the lesson, saved with its formulas or calculation notes
Knowledge check result (a quiz result is not a practical competence result)
stopWorkCriteria: Do not store chemicals in a space shared with food or personal items
Stop and escalate any home-based or lease restriction that is not yet checked
Do not rely on insurance cover for stored tools until the policy wording is read
